name: tally
description: Self-hosted, cookie-free web analytics: the tracker, event collector and stats API. The dashboard runs separately on Vercel.

API_SECRET.description: Shared secret for the dashboard's calls to /v1. Generated for you; copy it into the dashboard's API_SECRET on Vercel.

ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH.description: The dashboard password, hashed. Make it with `go run github.com/Gitax18/tally/cmd/server@latest hash-password` (or `go run ./cmd/server hash-password` in a clone) and paste the whole scrypt$... line.

RETENTION_MONTHS.description: Events and visits older than this many months are deleted daily.

DB_LIMIT_MB.description: Your Postgres plan's storage limit in MB, for the dashboard's storage meter (Essential-0: 1024, Essential-1: 10240).
